$comment: BarelySain TikTok V3 frame sequence and cut timing. Durations are a starting recommendation, not an approved cut; see docs/CODEX_MODELING_TIKTOK_BRIEF.md.

source.note: Repo copies are 1440x1920 derivatives, sufficient for a 1080x1920 render. Full-resolution masters live in the archive and in the Drive folder.

narrative: before -> person -> city -> campaign -> coast -> payoff
rhythm: Slow open so the on-screen text can be read, accelerate through the campaign run, decelerate and hold the final frame.

frames.note: Hook frame. Held long enough for the on-screen line to be read.
Second half of the text read.
The reveal beat. Do not rush this one.
Subject sits small and low in frame. Crop needs checking; a centre crop weakens it.
Hold. The last frame carries the caption landing.

alternates.reason: Original crosswalk frame, landscape 4011x3008 EXIF Orientation 6. Intended for the modeling page, not the video.
Window reflection over downtown towers, second city option
Phone in hand, apartment. A more casual opener.
Neon sign, full body. Different interior register.
Red Ferrari against the green shoe
Cropped waist and garment detail by the car
